reviews.title: Suspect App!!!!
reviews.text:
I’m currently trying this app on a seven-day trial, and I’ve already noticed some concerning privacy issues.

Firstly, when uploading multiple photographs, I noticed that location information was being included. This potentially reveals exactly where those photographs were taken. Why does an AI photo-generation app need this information?

I continued testing the app, but then encountered something even more concerning.

After generating an image, I attempted to save it. The app insisted that I grant full access to my photo library simply to download the picture.

Why would an app need unrestricted access to my entire photo library just to save one image?

Even more bizarrely, when I followed the instructions into my iPhone settings, I discovered that the app already had full access! Yet it still refuses to save the generated pictures.

Currently, my only option is to take screenshots.

I find this extremely concerning. It raises serious questions about whether this app is requesting more personal information than it actually needs to function.

I’m not claiming that information is being misused, but I’d certainly like the developers to explain why these permissions are necessary.

For an app handling people’s personal photographs, privacy and transparency should be a priority, not an afterthought.

reviews.title: Billing Issues and Disappointing Features
reviews.text:
I cancelled my subscription in advance, and the app clearly showed that my subscription would expire on the 11th. Despite that, I was still charged again on the 14th for a renewal I did not authorize. When I contacted Apple about the charge, they told me the purchase was not eligible for reimbursement, which makes the situation even more frustrating. Im currently in the process of fighting it. 

Beyond the billing issue, the app itself was not as advertised. The photo suggestions and AI-generated recommendations were underwhelming and didn’t provide the quality or usefulness that the marketing suggests. I expected much better results given how the app promotes its capabilities.

Between the unexpected charge and the disappointing features, this has been a very poor user experience. I would caution others to be careful with the subscription and not expect the results the app claims to deliver.
